payload.title: Ship the fixed classifier bundle: optimized example list, rubric, and head
payload.description:
## Purpose

Give the Decision Flywheel one frozen, reloadable default classifier: a native optimizer improves one fixed few-shot example list across feedback rounds, and the winner is saved with the discovered rubric questions and the trained head.

## Product definition (owner, 2026-10-01)

- **One flywheel, two optimizations:** feature discovery from labeled feedback and its explanations (Jev-Flywheel steering, consumed read-only) and iterative few-shot example-list optimization (this epic).
- **Default end state:** a fixed `ClassifierBundle` = optimized fixed example list + rubric questions + trained head over Jev answers. Default cost: 2 Jev requests per item.
- **Dynamic per-item retrieval is separate and optional**, off by default (sibling retrieval epic).
- Native and provider-neutral. No DSPy dependency, bridge, or optimization path.

## Scope

The core-owned pieces in design §1.3: `FixedExampleList` policy, Brier objective, `improve_example_list` driver, `ClassifierBundle`. Reuse `ContextPolicy`, `validate_selected_context`, `search_context_policies`, `call_accounting`, and the `artifacts.py` canonical-JSON pattern. Do not add a third copy of `Score`/`fit_head` (design §1.3; ownership question Q4 stays open).

## Definition of done

All child stories closed, specs first and green (`make test`). The evaluations harness runs arms F / F-rand / A-c+F against these APIs offline (stop S0), and reloaded bundles give identical predictions to in-memory ones.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1, §3, §6 steps 1, 2, 9.
